services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: Prices listed are not per person; prices listed are for chartering the boat. When you charter the boat it is yours with up to 6 passengers maximum in your group. The mighty Bluefin tuna or as referred to in Days of Old, the horse mackerel, spends its summer and fall off the coast of Cape Cod. Tuna show up here every season to gorge themselves on the smorgasbord of bait off our coast. The crew of the Magellan has over 25 years experience catching these magnificent fish. In 2009 Captain Jason caught our biggest fish to date weighing in at 1,039 pounds.
